title: Maximum Array Hopping Score I
summary: Starting from index 0, navigate through an array to reach the final element with the highest score.
statement: Starting from index 0, navigate through an array to reach the final element with the highest score. Each hop from index i to j (where j > i) awards a score of (j - i) multiplied by the value at index j. Determine the greatest possible score.
constraints: nums contains at least two positive integers.
Start at index zero and make strictly rightward hops until reaching the final index.
A hop i to j scores (j-i)*nums[j]; maximize the total score.
reference_solution:
def maximum_array_hopping_score(nums):
    best=0;answer=0
    for index in range(len(nums)-1,0,-1):best=max(best,nums[index]);answer+=best
    return answer

def maximum_array_hopping_score(nums):
    best=0;answer=0
    for index in range(len(nums)-2,0,-1):best=max(best,nums[index]);answer+=best
    return answer
hints: Expand every hop score into one copy of its destination value for each crossed unit gap.
For each gap, choose the greatest array value to its right; suffix maxima make these choices compatible as hop endpoints.
Scan destinations right to left, add the running maximum for every gap.
Suffix-maximum changes identify an increasing sequence of hop destinations that realizes all independently optimal gap contributions.
